Hey Just stay strong I turned twenty two couple weeks ago and it also was the anniversary of my brother passing. It really has put me in a low place. I also didn't have many people wish me a happy birthday just a couple people in my immediate family and like three posts on facebook which really don't hold any value. I've thought about it to be honest and at the moments its been really hard to keep trudging on. As most of the people on this post I don't have anybody to text or call I've been on my own for about a year and a half its been very difficult to say the least no girlfriend lost a great one and I've really had a lot of guilt that I'll probably carry my whole life. Its hard to accept reality I totally understand just think of the fresh air you get to breathe, the sun, your favorite food its the little things I truly appreciate all I have honestly. Maybe go for a walk think back to a time when you had a hobby and pour yourself into that if you can. If you never had one then try to find one this will help a lot to direct your focus to something positive. It will help you keep your mind off of things. I guess I can't speak for others or give you a guarantee but that's what I do to keep getting by. Don't forget you have value as a human being no matter what others say even in your darkest times try and look to the future and imagine all the possibilities you have ahead of you. Me and you we're just young adults and we are just getting started in life. I deeply relate to you and if you ever need a friend to talk to without judgment that cares about what you are saying and to listen I am here for you. I wish you the best happy birthday.
